grf.observed_anchor: A frozen one-file EntityOS baseline executes from its normal extracted artifact location, but final one-file packaging should not secretly require a writable launch directory or its canonical filename.
grf.hypothesis: The frozen one-file boundary is launch-path independent enough to execute after rename from a read-only containing directory without emitting mandatory release sidecars beside itself.

grf.falsifier: Run the exact same artifact under an unprivileged uid from a renamed path inside a read-only containing directory, compare against a normal control, and inspect directory contents before/after.

exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment.name: READ_ONLY_RENAMED_LAUNCH_DIRECTORY_LESION
exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment.control: Same SHA-256 EntityOS baseline in a normal launch directory.
exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment.intervention: Same SHA-256 bytes renamed to E, containing directory mode 0555, executed as uid/gid 65534 with writable HOME/TMPDIR kept outside the launch directory.
exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment.rollback: Discard temporary directories; original downloaded artifact unchanged.
exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment.scope: Packaging/launch-boundary evidence for historical baseline only; does not prove no temporary extraction elsewhere, full static portability, persistence semantics, or current-head acceptance.
